scope: Visible definitions and benefits for prebiotics, probiotics and synbiotics; clearer microbiota-gut-brain explanation and product composition connections

sources.supports: Prebiotics feed beneficial microbes; digestive function and bowel regularity are among studied benefits.
Digestive and immune benefits depend on strain, formulation, dose and use.
Synbiotic definition requires health benefit for the combination; benefits cannot be inferred solely from ingredient lists.
Neural, metabolic and immune communication in the microbiota-gut-brain axis; intestinal barrier, microbial metabolites and stress responses.
Vitamin B6 participates in neurotransmitter biosynthesis. This ingredient role is not a clinical efficacy claim for Concentra+.

product_composition: Checked against original src/catalog.ts ingredient lists. Product connections describe composition and nutritional purpose; finished-product benefits are not inferred from these general references.
reading: No accordion or example ingredient list in the prebiotic definition. Benefits and importance are always visible within the selected tab, with a primary source immediately below.
validation: Production build, all six tabs, source links, 320px line measurement: 4/4/5 lines for ingredient benefits and 5/5/5 for pathway importance; no clipping or horizontal overflow.
